plugins.name: reel-lab
plugins.description: Turns raw 9:16 talking-head clips into a finished Instagram reel in your own named editing style, rebuilt from reels you love or picked in the Studio Picker: best takes, cuts, captions, animation, 46 effects and sound. Plus carousels in your own look, from a topic or from any video, and posting to Instagram (trial reels too), TikTok and YouTube for you.
